signoff: Built in Bengaluru  ·  Open to collaboration

segs.text: Every year, a Bengaluru commuter loses about 168 hours to rush-hour traffic.
parts: Every year, a Bengaluru commuter loses about 168 hours to rush-hour traffic.

segs.text: That's one full week. Standing still.
parts: That's one full week. Standing still.

segs.text: Ten kilometres takes about thirty-six minutes.
parts: Ten kilometres takes about thirty-six minutes.

segs.text: Traffic isn't one problem. It's signals, buses, the metro, roadworks and weather, all working alone.
parts: It's signals, buses, the metro, roadworks and weather, all working alone.

segs.text: What if they talked to each other?
parts: What if they talked to each other?

segs.text: Signals that learn from the roads around them. One live map for every bus and train. Roadworks planned with real data, open for anyone to check.
parts: Signals that learn from the roads around them.
One live map for every bus and train.
Roadworks planned with real data, open for anyone to check.

segs.text: Intelligence to plan it. A shared, trusted record, so everyone can believe the data.
parts: A shared, trusted record, so everyone can believe the data.

segs.text: No one builds this alone. Not one company. Not one department.
parts: Not one company. Not one department.

segs.text: It takes engineers, planners, citizens, and the people who run our cities, working from the same truth.
parts: It takes engineers, planners, citizens, and the people who run our cities, working from the same truth.

segs.text: Rivers become an ocean when they meet.
parts: Rivers become an ocean when they meet.

segs.text: Let's give Bengaluru its week back.
parts: Let's give Bengaluru its week back.
